about: Curated metadata for every bridge op: the area guide it belongs to, its effect (read | write | run | destructive | ui), a one-line plain-English summary, and the two cues an agent must not miss (asks = the user gets a confirmation dialog; plan = it only previews unless that flag is passed). test/test_manual_content.js fails when a registered op has no entry or an entry names an op that does not exist; node tools/manual_meta.js prints a starter entry for each missing op.
